input_diagnostics.depth_convention: unchanged author field interpreted as axial z proxy

process_receipt.rss_sampling: worker PID ps at about 0.1-second intervals; peaks may be missed

timing_semantics.candidate_generation_seconds: Historical sum of all four original candidate process wall times; frontend cost unavailable
timing_semantics.output_seconds: Score validation and finite JSON conversion/encoding; file writes are also charged by whole worker/process wall
timing_semantics.score_seconds: One core score_pair call for every candidate and all five selectors
